instrument: Misty Hollow Energy & Data Campus preliminary plan (614 Prospect Rd)
summary: Preliminary plan for about 1 million sq ft of data center on about 274 acres, with an 80,000 sq ft wastewater plant and about 10 acres of on-site gas-fired generation (300 MW). The Sept 24 Planning Commission meeting was canceled after a large opposition turnout; rescheduling expected Oct 1.
notes: Update to existing entry. Forward Township has no zoning ordinance; a SALDO amendment for industrial development is expected before supervisors in November, but the plan was submitted before it would take effect. 300 MW is generation capacity, not IT load. Pennsylvania municipalities may not exclude a use entirely.
